keyEvents.text: Junior Diaz (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Troyes 1, Le Mans 0. Mouhamed Diop (Troyes) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Timothé Nkada.
First Half ends, Troyes 1, Le Mans 0.
Substitution, Le Mans. Billal Brahimi replaces Habib Diallo.
Substitution, Troyes. Kandet Diawara replaces Timothé Nkada.
Substitution, Le Mans. Dame Gueye replaces Antoine Rabillard.
Raúl Torrente (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Paolo Gozzi (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Le Mans. Jean Vercruysse replaces Alexandre Lauray.
Substitution, Troyes. Ismaël Boura replaces Paolo Gozzi.
Nicolas Kocik (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card.
Ismaël Boura (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Troyes 2, Le Mans 0. Ismaël Boura (Troyes) left footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Noa Boissé (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Le Mans. Yasser Larouci replaces Lucas Calodat.
Substitution, Le Mans. William Harhouz replaces Louis Mafouta.
Substitution, Troyes. Jérémy Le Douaron replaces Renaud Ripart.
Substitution, Troyes. Iron Gomis replaces Mouhamed Diop.
Substitution, Troyes. Hugo Picard replaces Merwan Ifnaoui because of an injury.
Samuel Yohou (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Troyes 2, Le Mans 0.
